_comment: Machine-readable version of content-calendar.md, feed posts only (the 3 Reels in week 4 need an actual recorded video file, so they stay manual — see content-calendar.md). Consumed by scripts/post_to_instagram.py via the instagram-autopost GitHub Actions workflow. Do not hand-edit 'posted' — the workflow updates it after a successful publish. Dates are calendar dates in the account's assumed local timezone (see social/instagram-api-setup.md for the timezone note). Each post is now a 3-slide carousel (English, then Portuguese, then Spanish — see social/carousels/, built by scripts/build_social_carousels.py), since a single Instagram post can't show different content per viewer the way the website can. The caption below covers all three slides, English first, translations after a 'Swipe' note.
